# Lab 7.9: Data Preparation with Gemini

## What We Are Going to Do
Clean a messy table with a data preparation, accept AI suggestions, and write the result to a new table.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create a messy table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab07.messy_customers AS
SELECT * FROM UNNEST([
  STRUCT(' asha patel ' AS name, 'SURAT' AS city, '9876543210' AS phone, '2024/01/05' AS joined),
  ('Ravi Kumar', 'pune ', '+91-98765-43211', '05-02-2024'),
  ('meera  shah', 'Mumbai', NULL, '2024-03-10'),
  ('Asha Patel', 'Surat', '9876543210', '2024/01/05')
]);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Create a data preparation.** Open `messy_customers`, click **Open in → Data preparation**.

3. **[Console] Apply the suggestions.** Gemini proposes steps such as **Trim**, **Title case** for `name` and `city`, **Parse date** for `joined`, and **Remove duplicates**. Click **Apply** on the ones you agree with. Add one yourself: **Filter** where `phone IS NOT NULL`.

4. **[Console] Set the destination and run.** Click **Destination**, choose `lab07.clean_customers`, write mode **Full refresh**. Click **Run**.

5. **[SQL] Check the result.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

</code></pre>
</div>


6. **[Console] See the code.** Each data preparation is stored as a code asset. Open its **SQLX** view to see the SQL that the steps generate.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Suggestions | Trim, case, date parsing, dedupe |
| Steps | Visual, editable, stored as code |
| Output | `lab07.clean_customers` |
| Reuse | Can be added to a pipeline and scheduled |
